cases.input: Two firms sponsor a temporary delivery team.
cases.expect: Sponsors and one record authority are explicit; participant assignments do not invent membership.

cases.input: A standing community admits practitioners under governed terms.
cases.expect: WM-ORG-006 memberships coexist with any temporary team assignments.

cases.input: One person joins a community and a delivery team.
cases.expect: Separate membership and assignment records reference the same person.

cases.input: Community membership automatically grants access to both firms' products.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; explicit owner-issued grants are required.

cases.input: Closing a temporary team terminates participant employment.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; employment remains externally mastered.
